## Published Information

- [Quiz 1](quiz-01.qmd): an individual, 15-minute, in-class Blackboard quiz
  during Week 4.
- [Quiz 2](quiz-02.qmd): an individual, 15-minute, in-class Blackboard quiz on
  30 September or 1 October, covering MATLAB material from Weeks 1-5.
- [Project 1](../projects/project-1-eda.qmd): one complete group package due
  Thursday, 24 September 2026, at 9:00 AM UAE time.

## Confirmed Upcoming Dates

- **Common midterm:** Saturday, 10 October 2026, from 12:00 to 1:30 PM. Both
  sections take the examination simultaneously outside regular class hours.

The syllabus shows the complete assessment rhythm. Detailed preparation and
permitted-material instructions for the midterm, later quizzes, the final
examination, and Project 2 will be published before each assessment.

::: {.callout-note}
## Where to look

This website explains what an assessment measures and how to prepare.
Blackboard gives the calendar date, access window, submission link, grades, and
any individual accommodation. The latest Blackboard announcement is
authoritative for logistics.
:::

## General Expectations

- Follow the permitted-use statement on the assessment page.
- Ask before the assessment if an instruction or accommodation is unclear.
- Keep project work reproducible and disclose AI assistance as required by the
  [AI policy](../syllabus/ai-policy.qmd).
- A short oral verification may be requested when there is a substantial and
  unexplained mismatch between project work and individually assessed work.
